name: sec-pay-psp
description: Sec4 Pay is a PCI DSS-aligned Payment Service Provider (PSP) platform designed to provide digital banks and card issuers with secure and efficient payment processing capabilities, built on MongoDB.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix packages/eventbus && npm install --prefix packages/platform-links && npm install --prefix psp/frontend && npm install --prefix psp/backend && npm install --prefix bank/backend && npm install --prefix merchant && npm install --prefix bank/frontend
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --prefix packages/eventbus && npm run build --prefix packages/platform-links
scripts.setup:reset: npm run setup:db:reset && npm run setup:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:bankcore" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:bankfront" "npm run dev:merchant"
scripts.dev:restart: npm run dev:stop && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --prefix psp/frontend && npm run build --prefix psp/backend && npm run build --prefix bank/backend && npm run build --prefix merchant
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:ci: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.type-check: tsc --noEmit --project packages/eventbus/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/platform-links/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project psp/backend/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project bank/backend/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project psp/frontend/tsconfig.json
